item.tib: spyi spungs gab pa gsang chen las bka' nyan drag rtsal gza' bdud srog sgrub
item.coloph: de ltar khro bo spyi spungs gab pa gsung chen las/ pho nya gza' mchog chen po'i srog sgrub 'di yang stag lha'i thugs sprul dbra khyung sngags 'chang khro bo lha rgod thog pa'i thugs las chad pa'i bu dbal 'bar stag slag can bdag la srid pa'i rgyal mos snyan du brgyud pa 'dis kyang / dam nyams bstan dgra log pa'i srog gshed du gyur cig/
